info.title: API.SH: Sam's Club
info.description: The Sam's Club API from API.SH: public Sam's Club data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products in a Sam's Club (US) category: the category's name and breadcrumbs, total and pages, and each product's item id, name, type, price, was price, savings, unit price, rating and review count, availability, promotions, fulfillment options, sponsored flag and image, about 45 per page, plus the filter facets (each value has a `facet` to pass back in `facet`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page. Pass `club` (an id from `/samsclub/v1/club`) for that club's prices, stock and items.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsclub-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric category id (the number at the end of a samsclub.com/browse/... link). Pass this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A samsclub.com category link, e.g. `https://www.samsclub.com/browse/tires/1056`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name(s), comma separated.

parameters.name: facet
parameters.description: A `facet` value from a previous response; several joined with `||`.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: A club id from `/samsclub/v1/club` (e.g. `6308`, Columbus Hilliard). Prices, stock and the items carried are then that club's; `club` in the response names it. Without it the site's default club is used (its id is in `club`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Sam's Club's club finder: the nearest clubs to a ZIP code, city or address with id, name, address, distance, position, phone, time zone, opening hours and early-shopping hours, services, temporary closure, curbside and same-day pickup, delivery, Scan & Go and Instacart flags, and the club page link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsclub-club

parameters.description: ZIP code, city or address.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles (default 50).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of clubs (up to 50, default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Sam's Club product: price, was price and savings, availability, brand, model, UPC, short and long description, highlights, specifications, warranty, breadcrumbs, images, variants, promotions, return policy, rating breakdown and top reviews. `reviews_count` is the catalog count (the one search shows); `reviews_served` is how many reviews the item's own reviews page serves, which can be lower.

`variant_products` lists every size/colour combination with its own price, availability, link and image; `pricing` adds the savings amount, unit and comparison price, volume tiers, the price per channel (shipping, pickup, delivery) and the member limit; `fulfillment` gives the shipping, club pickup and delivery options with availability, quantity and delivery date, and the club and ZIP they apply to. Pass `club` for one club's price and stock; `club_availability` sums up its pickup and delivery stock.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsclub-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric item id (the number at the end of a samsclub.com/ip/ URL), or pass `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A samsclub.com product URL.

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: A club id from `/samsclub/v1/club` (e.g. `6308`, Columbus Hilliard). Prices, stock and the items carried are then that club's; `club` in the response names it. Without it the site's default club is used (its id is in `club`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
